{{Quote|"The Association of Architects is so awful..."
}}'''Galatea''' is a female NPC in Septimont and apprentice architect of the Association of Architects. She can be seen with [[Flamaxis]]m listening to [[Aucustus]] speech.

== Idle ==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Aucustus:''' Remember, you're not just plastering cement! You're building the very walls of this city!
:'''Aucustus:''' We are the Association of Architects! We are the builders of Septimont!
:'''Aucustus:''' Architects! Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
:'''Flamaxis:''' Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
:'''Galatea:''' Sheesh, I thought I was here for construction work. No one told me I'm supposed to be donating organs...
:'''Galatea:''' The Association of Architects is so awful...
{{Dialogue End}}

== Dialogue ==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Galatea:''' Goodness... Such a shame our chairman didn't chose the career of a motivational speaker...
:'''Flamaxis:''' Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont! Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
:{{DIcon|Option}} Listen in.
::'''Galatea:''' Calm down, Flamaxis! Are you out of your mind?
::'''Flamaxis:''' Doesn't your heart swell with pride upon hearing those words? Where's your sense of honor?
::'''Flamaxis:''' Morta, Decuma, and Nona. Three great walls. All built by our Association!
::'''Galatea:''' ...But no matter how well they were built, you're still out here plastering cement, aren't you?
::'''Flamaxis:'''So what? I'm still young! Being an apprentice is great, and easy to find jobs! If you think construction work is so hard, I don't think you'll fare very well doing something else!
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
